Architecture Overview

The payments platform exposes an HTTPS API that stores payment records in a database. Customers interact through a web checkout experience. The system is business critical but several operational details are still being confirmed.

Known components

ComponentTechnology
Payments APIPython service
Payment databasePostgreSQL
Web checkoutReact application

Known data flows

  • Web checkout calls the Payments API over HTTPS.
  • Payments API persists transactions to PostgreSQL.

Authentication

Customers authenticate with OAuth 2.0. Administrator MFA policy is under review.

Open questions and missing information

  • Application owner and on-call rotation are not documented.
  • Deployment regions and disaster recovery strategy are not defined.
  • Trust boundaries between DMZ and internal services are not shown.
  • Queue, cache, and external processor integrations are not described.
  • Token lifetime and session timeout values are not specified.
  • Backup retention and encryption-at-rest settings are not confirmed.
